  - main:
    - text: CLASS 12 · DIFFERENTIAL EQUATIONS
    - heading "General and Particular Solutions" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Compare the general solution (family) of y′=y with particular solutions determined by initial conditions. Move, explore, and verify in real time.
    - text: 18 min ADVANCED CONCEPT calculus
    - 'heading "SOLUTION FAMILY EXPLORER: y′ = y" [level=3]'
    - complementary:
      - heading "General solution (family)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: y=Ceˣ, C∈ℝ
      - paragraph: Move the C slider or drag the point on the y-axis (x=0) to choose a particular solution.
      - text: C (arbitrary constant)
      - slider "C constant": "2"
      - paragraph: Selected C = 2
      - separator
      - heading "Initial condition at x=0" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Drag the point on the y-axis.
      - text: y(0) = 2
      - heading "Family members (y=Ceˣ)" [level=3]
      - checkbox "C=-2 y=-2eˣ" [checked]
      - text: C=-2 y=-2eˣ
      - checkbox "C=-1 y=-1eˣ" [checked]
      - text: C=-1 y=-1eˣ
      - checkbox "C=0 y=0" [checked]
      - text: C=0 y=0
      - checkbox "C=1 y=1eˣ" [checked]
      - text: C=1 y=1eˣ
      - checkbox "C=2 y=2eˣ" [checked]
      - text: C=2 y=2eˣ
      - button "Reset view":
        - img
        - text: Reset view
    - text: y=-2eˣ y=-1eˣ y=0 y=1eˣ y=2eˣ (selected)
    - img "Exponential solution family": (0, 2)
    - button "Zoom out":
      - img
    - button "Zoom in":
      - img
    - button "Fit graph":
      - img
    - heading "LIVE VERIFICATION (for the selected solution y=2eˣ)" [level=3]
    - paragraph: y=2eˣ ⇒ y′=2eˣ ⇒ y′−y=0
    - strong: "✓ Verified: y′−y=0 identically for all x."
    - heading "GENERAL SOLUTION vs PARTICULAR SOLUTION" [level=3]
    - article:
      - heading "GENERAL SOLUTION (family)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: y=Ceˣ C∈ℝ (arbitrary constant)
      - list:
        - listitem: Contains an arbitrary constant C.
        - listitem: Represents infinitely many solutions.
        - listitem: Satisfies y′−y=0 for every C.
        - listitem: No specific initial data used.
      - strong: Infinite possibilities
    - article:
      - heading "PARTICULAR SOLUTION (determined)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: y=2eˣ (from y(0)=2)
      - list:
        - listitem: Constant fixed by an initial condition.
        - listitem: Single, unique solution within the family.
        - listitem: Satisfies y′−y=0.
        - listitem: Matches y(0)=2.
      - strong: Unique solution
    - complementary:
      - heading "SINGULAR / EQUILIBRIUM SOLUTION" [level=3]
      - paragraph: y=0 is an equilibrium solution since y′=0 when y=0. It belongs to the family with C=0.
      - text: Trajectories do not cross the equilibrium solution.
    - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Solve y′=2x with y(1)=3.
    - list:
      - listitem: "Integrate: y=∫2x dx=x²+C."
      - listitem: "Apply y(1)=3: 3=1²+C ⇒ C=2."
      - listitem: "Particular solution: y=x²+2."
    - complementary:
      - heading "CHECK (verify)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: y′=2x.
      - paragraph: "At x=1: y(1)=1²+2=3 ✓"
      - paragraph: "Equation satisfied: y′=2x ✓"
    - 'heading "PRACTICE: INITIAL-CONDITION TASK" [level=3]'
    - paragraph: Solve y′=y with the given initial condition.
    - paragraph: Set y(0)=1.
    - text: What is the particular solution?
    - heading "Select your answer" [level=3]
    - radio "y=eˣ" [checked]
    - text: y=eˣ
    - radio "y=2eˣ"
    - text: y=2eˣ
    - radio "y=eˣ+1"
    - text: y=eˣ+1
    - radio "y=xeˣ"
    - text: y=xeˣ
    - complementary:
      - heading "Check your work" [level=3]
      - paragraph: "General solution: y=Ceˣ."
      - paragraph: "Apply y(0)=1: 1=Ce⁰ ⇒ C=1."
      - paragraph: Therefore, y=eˣ.
      - button "Check answer"
